targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [V3-EXQ-642b, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-642b_2026-09-01] V3-EXQ-642b did NOT test whether z_block rises under blocked agency, for the same structural reason as its predecessor. C1 and C2 read only z_block_peak, a max statistic against the hard clamp z_block_cap=1.5 (ree_core/affect/blocked_agency.py:153); both arms reach exactly 1.500 on all 3 seeds, so z_block_separation is 0.0 by arithmetic and both load-bearing criteria are false regardless of behaviour. C2 additionally subtracts a z_harm_a separation that is a structural 0.0 (harm pinned at zero by design). The self-routed label 'z_block_integrator_no_rise' is INCORRECT. The substrate build under validation WORKED: the baseline-relative outcome_mismatch_floor (ree-v3 d49db86f3e64670) moved CONTROL z_block_mean from 642a's 1.26-1.35 to 0.064-0.177 and improved BLOCK-CONTROL mean separation 4.1x-9.3x, from +0.165/+0.121/+0.083 to +0.681/+0.590/+0.771. On the recorded z_block_mean, against the SAME pre-registered margins (C1_MARGIN 0.20, Z_BLOCK_MIN 0.20, C2_MARGIN 0.20), C1 and C2 pass on 3/3 seeds. The peak degeneracy was named in advance by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-642a_2026-08-30 (generated 2026-08-30T06:34:18Z, one day before this run executed), whose learning_extracted[1] recommended a headroom DV; the successor implemented the substrate half of that diagnosis and by design reused the criterion. Residual finding: CONTROL still reaches peak 1.500 at a mean of 0.064-0.177, so the integrator saturates on transients even in a free arm. Secondary: the manifest's z_goal_stream.writer_defect true (writer_calls 0 over 14400 ticks) is NOT a defect in this run -- the driver deliberately pins the goal at a fixed magnitude (GOAL_PIN = 0.5, _pin_goal() at v3_exq_642a_blocked_agency_zblock_discriminative.py:224, invoked at :268/:304/:333/:354/:373), which sets z_goal directly and bypasses the counted writer; that is why ticks_active reads 14400/14400 and active_frac 1.0 alongside zero writer calls, a combination an omitted update_z_goal could not produce. Neither C0 nor C3 reads a goal-dependent statistic. This is a live instance of 642a's learning_extracted[3]: the detector cannot separate an omitted update_z_goal from a deliberately pinned constant goal and here mislabels a correct control as a defect. MECH-353's v3_pending gate is NOT cleared and NOT contradicted. PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

learning_extracted: Repairing one of two co-diagnosed defects and re-running inherits the other at full cost. failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-642a_2026-08-30 named the peak degeneracy and the floor miscalibration together; 642b fixed only the floor and spent a 24-minute 6-run validation on a criterion already shown to be arithmetically dead.

'Reuse the pre-registered threshold verbatim' is the right default and the wrong move once a prior autopsy has shown the STATISTIC cannot vary. The anti-fabrication rule protects a threshold from being moved to fit a result; it does not oblige reuse of a degenerate statistic. Re-derive the criterion's reachability in the fixed regime -- the same lesson 936a's learning_extracted[1] records for the MECH-439 family.

A validation run's success condition should be stated on the statistic its criterion actually consumes. 642a's failure_record.target was worded on the peak difference, which is unachievable while any transient touches the clamp, even though the calibration it was testing succeeded on the mean.

A max-statistic against a hard clamp is degenerate for a SUSTAINED-elevation hypothesis in a way a mean is not: a single transient excursion in the control arm zeroes the difference. Where a clamp exists, prefer mean / AUC / time-to-threshold and always record the saturation fraction.

The z_goal writer-defect detector mislabels a DELIBERATELY PINNED goal as a dead stream. writer_calls=0 with active_frac=1.0 and ticks_active == ticks_total is the signature of a pin (a driver setting z_goal directly), not of an omitted update_z_goal, which cannot produce a full active_frac. 642a's learning_extracted[3] predicted this ambiguity and this run is a live instance of it reaching pending_review.md as a data-quality flag it is not.

targets.z_goal_writer_defect_note: The pending_review.md 'Dead z_goal stream' row for this run is a FALSE POSITIVE. writer_calls=0 arises because the driver pins the goal (GOAL_PIN=0.5, _pin_goal) rather than writing it through REEAgent.update_z_goal. active_frac 1.0 with ticks_active 14400/14400 is the tell that this is a pin, not an omission. Recommend the detector learn the pinning path, or that pinning drivers stamp the reason.
